description:
### 🚀 Gboard 18.5.4 (v4.3.0) Release

* **Upstream Sync & Enhancements**: Fully synchronized with upstream v4.3.0 (Frosted Glass FAQ & nav-bar rendering fixes, select-all editing shortcuts, high-performance settings search engine, spacebar custom logo images, language model controls, keypress haptics).
* **Custom Font & Modern Emoji**: Registered full-text search indexing for custom fonts (Chinese, English & Pinyin keywords); added one-tap 'Reset to Default Font' action; dynamic active font filename and file size summary display.
* **Absolute Privacy Hardening**: Strictly stripped LAN FTP Server, Web Clipboard, and QuickJS network execution to eliminate any local network information leak risks.

### 🚀 版本發布 (v4.3.0)

* **上游特性全量同步**：完整同步上游 v4.3.0 最新特性（磨砂玻璃 FAQ 與導覽列延伸透明度修復、全選快捷編輯手勢、設定全文快速搜尋、空白鍵自訂圖片與彩色圖示、語言模型與按鍵震動強度等）。
* **自訂字型與現代 Emoji 增強**：全面接入設定全文搜尋引擎（支援字體、emoji、豆腐塊等中英關鍵字檢索）；新增「一鍵恢復系統預設字型」捷徑；設定摘要即時感知當前字型檔名與檔案大小。
* **極致隱私安全加固**：徹底剝離局域網 FTP、網頁剪貼簿及 QuickJS 外部網路腳本，維持零網路通訊純淨離線輸入。
